title: A message to another session cites a comment link only after the post that made it returned
why: Twice lane notes-fix-large-1 sent runner 8 a review-record link before its post returned; the second time a literal placeholder (#1945), corrected one message later (lane, 07:52 CST Nov 8).
note: Done check: a red test where the guard refuses a send_message holding a GitHub issuecomment link whose id appears in no earlier tool result, or holding the word PLACEHOLDER; a control where a link copied from a post result passes. A fix for a found gap (item 410 a). Slug from the lane; title by triage. Sighting (triage, 08:39 CST Nov 8): triage sent three messages citing roadmap commit c1a8444ed in the same call batch as its push. The push was refused (another writer moved the branch), and the rebased commit is c5d8d285e. The same rule covers a commit id: cite it only after the push that lands it returned. Sighting (lane agent-report-shas-resolve, 13:30 CST Nov 8): the lane sent the coordinator a record ref in the same response as the post, before the post returned; a correction message followed. Proposed check, folded here instead of a new step bare-comment-id-resolve: rule message-ref-missing also judges a bare `issuecomment-<id>`, or a cut-off one, against the PR the message names. Sighting (lane agent-report-shas-resolve, session_013NEJL1333yS5ziKFeWsjHC, 15:11 CST Nov 8; it asked for step bare-comment-id-resolve, which does not exist, so folded here): it sent the #2265 record ref in the same response as its post, and the ref was wrong (correct: issuecomment-6727182711). Second time. Proposed rule: a send_message must not cite a post made in the same response.
